purpose: Canonical evidence file for 2024. Only sourced records in this file are eligible for later card scoring.

records.title: US SEC approves spot Bitcoin ETP listings
records.summary: The SEC approved exchange rule changes allowing multiple spot Bitcoin exchange-traded products to list and trade in the United States after more than a decade of rejected proposals.
records.significance: The approval opened a mainstream regulated brokerage route to spot Bitcoin exposure and marked a major institutional transition for the asset.

sources.title: SEC — Statement on Approval of Spot Bitcoin ETPs

records.title: US spot Bitcoin ETPs begin trading
records.summary: The newly approved US spot Bitcoin ETPs began public trading on January 11, 2024, with roughly $4.6 billion of aggregate first-day trading volume reported in later filings.
records.significance: Launch day converted a decade-long regulatory campaign into live investment products from major issuers including BlackRock and Fidelity and the converted GBTC.

sources.title: SEC filing noting Jan. 11 trading commencement

relationships.title: US SEC approves spot Bitcoin ETP listings

records.title: Ethereum Dencun introduces blobs and EIP-4844
records.summary: Ethereum's Dencun upgrade activated at epoch 269,568 and introduced EIP-4844 blob transactions for cheaper temporary rollup data availability.
records.significance: Dencun sharply reduced the cost of many layer-2 transactions and established blobs as central infrastructure for Ethereum's rollup-centric scaling strategy.

records.title: BlackRock launches BUIDL tokenized fund on Ethereum
records.summary: BlackRock launched the USD Institutional Digital Liquidity Fund, BUIDL, as its first tokenized fund issued on a public blockchain, using Ethereum and Securitize.
records.significance: BUIDL was a major milestone in the convergence of traditional asset management, tokenized Treasury exposure and public-blockchain settlement.

records.title: Fourth Bitcoin halving
records.summary: At block 840,000, Bitcoin's block subsidy fell from 6.25 BTC to 3.125 BTC on April 20, 2024.
records.significance: The fourth halving continued Bitcoin's fixed issuance schedule into an era of spot ETPs and increasingly institutional mining.

records.title: SEC approves rule changes for spot Ether ETPs
records.summary: The SEC granted accelerated approval to exchange rule changes permitting the listing and trading of shares of multiple spot Ether exchange-traded products.
records.significance: The decision extended the US spot-crypto ETP framework beyond Bitcoin and marked Ether's arrival in mainstream regulated investment products.

records.title: US spot Ether ETPs begin public trading
records.summary: The approved US spot Ether ETPs commenced trading on July 23, 2024.
records.significance: The launch gave brokerage investors direct regulated exposure to spot Ether through exchange-traded products.

sources.title: SEC filing noting spot Ether ETP trading commencement

relationships.title: SEC approves rule changes for spot Ether ETPs

records.title: Mt. Gox begins Bitcoin and Bitcoin Cash creditor repayments
records.summary: The Mt. Gox rehabilitation trustee announced that repayments in Bitcoin and Bitcoin Cash began on July 5, 2024, with additional distributions continuing through July and August.
records.significance: A decade after Mt. Gox's collapse, creditors finally began receiving crypto distributions, closing one of the longest-running sagas in Bitcoin history.
